description: This file defines a Flutter widget `TrackOrderScreen` which displays a tracking order interface including a header, progress timeline, map illustration, ETA details, and a bottom navigation button. It includes internal classes and widgets such as `_Badge`, `_StatusRow`, `_TimelineConnector`, `_VehicleMarker`, and `_DestinationPin`, with references to assets (icons and images).

classes.name: TrackOrderScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the order tracking screen, composed of various UI components representing order status, map, ETA, and navigation.

classes.name: _Badge
classes.description: Small circular badge widget displaying notification count or similar indicator.

classes.name: _StatusRow
classes.description: Represents a single status step in the timeline with label and timestamp.

classes.name: _TimelineConnector
classes.description: Vertical line connector between status indicators in the timeline.

classes.name: _VehicleMarker
classes.description: Visual representation of a vehicle, used on the map illustration.

classes.name: _DestinationPin
classes.description: Pin marker indicating the destination on the map illustration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for the `TrackOrderScreen`, assembling header, status timeline, map placeholder, ETA card, and bottom button.
